description: This file contains helper functions for setting up and tearing down deprecation warnings within tests, including tracking expected and observed deprecations, and verifying that expected deprecations occur during test execution.

methods.name: setupDeprecationHandler
methods.description: Initializes deprecation handling in tests, setting expected deprecations, controlling suppression of warnings, and capturing deprecation events.

methods.name: teardownDeprecationHandler
methods.description: Restores deprecation warning settings and verifies that all expected deprecations occurred, throwing an error if any were missed.
